         **Review examples:**
            1. _rayray the stingray_, Aug 5, 2026, 4/5: "i LOVE Janitor AI, it's just that it glitches out so much, please fix it!!""
            2. _DevilsLegend13_, Aug 3, 2026, 4/5: "Responses are very detailed and I love that it appears to have no limit how much to add to your personas. However, I've noticed a few bugs ─ if I exit the app or turn off my phone while the bot is typing, it cut off mid sentence and say it's done. Not to mention, I've noticed I'll return to the app and open the bot to find that the bot's messages disappeared. Update: Correction ─ I scrolled up and turns out there's a ton of messages missing. Not just one."
            3. _Angry oce_, Jul 20, 2026, 4/5: "I love Janitor AI, love their website but the app have some bugs. One out of two times the response have an error “failed to save message” so I have to redo or else it never appears on the chat. Please fix it’s a big waste of time at every chat"
